outcome.statement: An adult hirer finishes an assessment, sees the placement on their profile, and skill and intelligence results stay on the account. Staff can see how many of those tools are saved. A child profile stays private and has no photo. Launch stays CLOSED 0/8.

goals.name: Durable tools
goals.statement: Skill and Intelligence results are server-scored rows on the member, one row per attempt.

goals.name: One chrome
goals.statement: One AppShell host. The navy coaching shell is retired.

goals.name: Adult placement
goals.statement: Enneagram, DISC, and Myers-Briggs lock at 75 percent confidence, or the run ends with an honest best read. The copy stays a Field School estimate.

goals.name: Profile shows the placement
goals.statement: The adult profile lists a locked category at 75 percent or higher and labels a weaker read as a best read.

goals.name: Staff count
goals.statement: The admin user snapshot counts saved tools for that email and returns the number alone.

goals.name: Fresh gates

goals.name: One gate write
